nkd_exit_policy_test.r1_finding: EOD dominates on NKD R1 just like on US futures. +328 annual EV, 100% win, worst $0. PT75 gives up 51 pts; SS25 craters at 38% win, -273 EV loss. Same dominance pattern as ES/NQ/RTY/YM.
nkd_exit_policy_test.m1_finding: SS75 is even MORE attractive on NKD M1. EOD worst is -500 (vs -216 on US); SS75 caps to -251 (vs -64 on US). EV cost: only -9 pts on NKD (vs -47 on US). SS75 essentially free tail-risk insurance on NKD.
nkd_exit_policy_test.conclusion: Locked rule set (R1 EOD, M1 SS75) transfers to NKD with no modification needed.

phase_4_kickoff.trigger_event: First real-market option quotes (IBKR, NQ + ES) on a live R1 signal day exposed that the BS-constant-vol backtest overestimates collectible credit. NQ R1 spec strikes priced at $158 credit / $7,341 max loss = 46:1 R:R. Breakeven win rate 97.9% vs backtest 94% -> uneconomic.
phase_4_kickoff.name: Phase 4 — Real-World Pricing
phase_4_kickoff.core_problem: Backtest used constant-vol BS pricing for both legs of each spread; real market has put-side skew + risk premium that the model ignores. The R1 / M1 spec strikes that looked positive-EV in backtest may not survive real option-chain pricing.

path_1_empirical_haircut.description: Sample real option chain prices for 10-20 historical R1/M1 setups. Compute average market-credit / model-credit ratio by (symbol, tier, vix_regime). Apply as haircut in backtest.
path_1_empirical_haircut.cost_estimate_usd: ~$20-40 of Databento for daily options chain over a few months
path_1_empirical_haircut.needs: cost-check on Databento for ES/NQ daily options chain data

path_3_live_decision_layer.description: At trade time, pull (or paste) live option chain quotes. Compute real R:R + market-implied PoP. Apply thresholds (R:R <= 8:1 AND market_PoP >= 88%) to TAKE/SKIP decision. Logs every candidate (taken or skipped) for empirical sample building.

deferred_paths.path_2_skew_aware_repricing: Full skew calibration + re-running full backtest. Defer until we have ~3 months of empirical data from Path 1+3.
deferred_paths.path_4_vol_surface_model: SVI / full surface model. Out of scope; would require team-level effort.

phase_4_kickoff.strategic_realization: R1's deep-OTM short strike (anchored at prev_close after a meaningful gap) is exactly where the market pays you the least. M1's ATM-anchored short captures real premium. The 'pricing problem' may actually be a 'strike selection' problem. A Phase 4 candidate rule: keep R1's signal filter (mid-VIX gap_down) but move K_short closer to spot (e.g., prev_close - 0.25*ATR). Preserves the directional filter, collects real credit.
phase_4_kickoff.todays_skipped_trades_logged: paper_trading/pricing_log.csv — 2 entries (ES modified, NQ spec). Both SKIP decisions; logged for empirical haircut calibration.

decision_thresholds_v1.rationale: 8:1 needs breakeven WR ~89%. Both R1 (backtest 94%) and M1 (backtest 56%) have specific WR profiles; M1 won't pass the PoP threshold so the threshold logic must be rule-aware or moved to per-rule. v1 is conservative; will calibrate after 10-20 samples.
